metadata.title: Implement Welcome Back Wizard Overdue Task Summary and Rescheduling Options

story.iWant: the "Welcome Back" wizard to show me my overdue tasks and give me clear options to reschedule them
story.soThat: I can easily choose how to get back on track and see my updated plan immediately.
story.tasks: - Enhance `WelcomeBackWizard` UI to display overdue task count. - Implement UI elements for rescheduling options ("Spread it Out", "Intensive Catch-up", "Fresh Start"). - Implement `onClick` handlers for these options within the `WelcomeBackWizard`. - On click, call `POST /reschedule-plan` with the correct `course_id` and `reason`. - Implement frontend logic to close the wizard and navigate to the dashboard upon successful plan update. - Implement visual feedback (e.g., loading spinner, animation) during the rescheduling process. - Ensure backend `ReschedulingService` correctly interprets and executes the "Welcome Back" rescheduling reasons.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. The "Welcome Back" wizard summarizes the count of overdue tasks (AC4 from Tech Spec). 2. The wizard presents simple options for rescheduling overdue tasks: "Spread it Out", "Intensive Catch-up", "Fresh Start" (AC4 from Tech Spec). 3. Selecting an option triggers a call to `POST /reschedule-plan` with the appropriate `reason` (e.g., "WELCOME_BACK_SPREAD") (AC5 from Tech Spec). 4. Upon successful plan update, the wizard closes and the user is returned to the dashboard with the newly organized plan visible (AC5 from Tech Spec). 5. Visual feedback (e.g., animation of calendar reorganizing) is provided after option selection and before returning to dashboard.

constraint.description: The wizard must provide clear, simple, and empathetic choices for rescheduling, along with immediate visual feedback, to guide the user back to the dashboard smoothly.
The rescheduling logic triggered by the wizard options must be efficient and complete within acceptable timeframes to ensure a responsive user experience.
Rescheduling requests initiated from the wizard must be properly authenticated and authorized, ensuring only the user's own plan is affected.
Plan updates resulting from the wizard's options must be accurately reflected on the dashboard immediately after the wizard closes.
The `ReschedulingService` must correctly interpret each of the "Welcome Back" reasons and apply the appropriate plan adjustment logic without data corruption.

tests.standards: Unit Tests (Backend): Develop comprehensive unit tests for the `ReschedulingService` to ensure it correctly interprets each "Welcome Back" reason (Spread it Out, Intensive Catch-up, Fresh Start) and applies the appropriate rescheduling logic, handling various plan states and edge cases. Component Tests (Frontend): Test the `WelcomeBackWizard` UI component's rendering of overdue task summaries, visual presentation of rescheduling options, and correct handling of user selections. Integration Tests (Frontend-Backend): Test the full communication flow from a user selecting an option in the `WelcomeBackWizard` to the `POST /reschedule-plan` endpoint call, and verify the successful plan update. E2E Tests: Simulate user login triggering the wizard, interact with different rescheduling options, and verify that the dashboard accurately reflects the updated plan upon the wizard's closure, including visual feedback.

ideas.idea: Component test: Verify the `WelcomeBackWizard` accurately displays the overdue task count (e.g., "You have 12 overdue tasks.").
Component test: Verify the wizard renders all three rescheduling options ("Spread it Out", "Intensive Catch-up", "Fresh Start") as interactive elements.
Integration test: Select "Spread it Out" in the wizard, verify `POST /reschedule-plan` is called with `reason: "WELCOME_BACK_SPREAD"`, and the backend returns success.
E2E test: Trigger the wizard, select "Intensive Catch-up", verify the wizard closes, the user returns to the dashboard, and the calendar shows the adjusted plan.
E2E test: Verify visual feedback (e.g., a loading spinner) is displayed while the plan is being updated after an option selection.
